descriptions.preferred: No description of this plant can be found in the old literature. It has a fiveor seven-lobed leaf of the Palmatum Group. The leaves measure 5-6 cm long and 5-7 cm wide, and the lobes are separated to just under threequarters of the way to the leaf base. Each lobe is oblong, terminating in a long, slender prominent tip. The lobes radiate outward, but the 3-cm middle lobes appear longer. The margins are lightly serrated. The red petioles are 4 cm long. The foliage has a yellow-green cast. The white variegation may consist of a few flecks to entire portions of Archives, Corvallis Archives, Corvallis ous, upright, medium-sized tree forms a tall roundtopped plant, probably reaching well over 7 m after 25 years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 在早期文献中找不到对此品种的描述。 其叶片属于 Palmatum Group，具 5 或 7 裂。 叶长 5 至 6 厘米，宽 5 至 7 厘米，裂片分离程度接近叶基的四分之三。 每个裂片均为长椭圆形，末端具细长而明显的尖尾。 裂片向外辐射展开，其中中间的裂片长约 3 厘米，显得更长。 叶缘具浅锯齿。 红色叶柄长 4 厘米。 叶色带黄绿色调。 白色斑纹可能仅为少量斑点，也可能扩展至叶片的大块区域。 该品种植株生长直立，为中等大小乔木，树形高大而圆顶，推测栽培 25 年后高度可远超 7 米。
